question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The state of being full or complete.
solution:
The correct answer is **Plenitude.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plenitude** means the situation when there is more than enough of something. (विपुलता; पूर्ण या पूर्ण होने की अवस्था या भाव; वह स्थिति जब किसी चीज की आवश्यकता से अधिक हो)

** • Example- ***The music brought him a feeling of **plenitude** and freedom.*

 
• So, it is clear that '**Plenitude'** can be used as a one-word substitute for '**The state of being full or complete.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plunder **means the action of stealing from people or places, especially during war or fighting; the goods that are stolen. (लूट)
 
• **Plebiscite **means a vote by the people of a country or a region on a question that is very important. (जनमत-संग्रह)
 
• **Pliability** means the quality of being easily bent; flexibility. (लचक)

 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
